bio: Along with the fine dining restaurant Schwarzer Hahn, St. Urban is part of the appealing culinary microcosm of the lovely Deidesheimer Hof hotel, which is located right on the historical market square. The cosy interior exudes the traditional charm of a Palatinate inn. Good regional and seasonal cuisine is served, à la carte or as a set menu. The menu also includes the classic Palatinate Favourite – Saumagen (stuffed pig's stomach), Bratwurst and liver dumplings with sauerkraut and mashed potatoes....
